title: Appendix A lifecycle invariants as a conformance suite
description: SPEC Appendix A / §12 Phase 0 step 7. Encode each of the thirteen invariants as a conformance test that any reconciler and any executor must pass, written against the Phase 0 schemas and a fake executor/reconciler harness so they can run before real reconciler code exists. Each test names its invariant and the live failure that earned it. Ships as part of the bundle so ticfac (Phase 1) inherits it unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Thirteen named tests exist, one per Appendix A invariant, each runnable from the bundle against a fake harness; the suite is green against the fake and is documented as the required gate for every executor; run-workflow.ts symbols the invariant lives in today are cross-referenced in each test's comment.
